topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its key themes and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic driver mutations and epigenetic remodeling confer competitive advantages and drive clonal selection during tumor progression.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cells
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell hypothesis and experimental evidence for cell-of-origin hierarchies driving leukemia and colorectal transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory signals and environmental promoters cooperate with existing mutations to induce stem-like states and drive malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Established Microenvironments, Profiling Technologies, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the ongoing cooperative dependence between established malignancies and their stroma, the spatial tools used to map these cellular interactions, and a comprehensive synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
